name: radar-chart
title: Radar Chart
description: A live radar (spider) chart for json-render chats: one to three subjects profiled across the same 3–8 measures on one scale, researched via Parallel, with its API route.
docs:
Turn the card on in the chat (one line in each file, see the comments in them):

  features/chat/chat-catalog.ts:   RadarChartCard: radarChartCatalogEntry
  features/chat/chat-registry.tsx: RadarChartCard: ({ props, loading }) => <LiveRadarChartCard topic={props.topic || undefined} streaming={loading} />
  features/chat/chat-steps.ts:     RadarChartCard: radarChartLookup

Figures load from /api/radar-chart (installed at app/api/radar-chart/route.ts). The route uses Parallel web search + extract (PARALLEL_API_KEY) and your AI Gateway model to score each subject on the same measures. Keep AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY set (same as chat). Topic is free text from the user's question.
